headline: Fun facts about GTA San Andreas
title: GTA San Andreas Fun Facts | CJ, Los Santos, San Fierro | Classic Games
video_script: Some fun facts about GTA San Andreas. It came out in two thousand four on PlayStation 2. The hero is Carl Johnson, or CJ, who returns to Los Santos after five years away. The map has three cities: Los Santos, San Fierro and Las Venturas. And it is considered the best-selling game ever on PlayStation 2. Which CJ mission do you still remember? Comment below!
